title: Suriya's Scene Scores 6.3/10 With Critics
headline: Suriya's Scene Scores 6.3/10 With Critics
caption:
Scene is a solid pass rather than a rave. Of the 7 reviews idly read in full, 6 credit Jithu Madhavan's fresh spin on the cop film and 5 say Suriya works against type; 4 find the pacing slack and 4 the investigation thin. Hindustan Times's Neeshita Nyayapati: "Suriya truly has fun poking fun at himself".

idly's consolidated score: 6.3/10, the mean of 15 numeric ratings from idly's fixed panel of 47 Indian English-language outlets (newspapers, TV and news sites, established film publications), published on or after release and confirmed on the outlet's page or in two independent listings, converted to /10.

Suriya plays a cop who would rather not be one: which star would you most like to see send up their own image next?

Sources: ratings from Cinema Express, Times of India, OnlyKollywood, Filmfare, Hindustan Times, India Today, NDTV, Pinkvilla, Indian Express, The Week, Deccan Herald, Great Andhra, Gulte, Telugu360 and Deccan Chronicle; read on the outlets' pages or in thereviewmonk, Rotten Tomatoes, Sacnilk and BollyMovieReviewz. Highs and lows from the 7 reviews idly read in full: The Week, Deccan Chronicle, The Federal, Gulte, THR India, Great Andhra and Telugu360.

Highs: Jithu Madhavan's fresh spin on a cop film (6 of 7); The support cast, led by Naslen, is strong (6 of 7); Suriya works, playing against type (5 of 7). Lows: The pacing sags in stretches (4 of 7); The investigation is thin or hard to follow (4 of 7).
